inputs.rig: art/characters/clone_01/motion/rig_002 (parts, rig-core, gait, proportions, webgl-character; files not modified)

method.projection: plane of the smoothed pelvis heading (circular mean, ±30 frames) viewed at an adjustable camera yaw: 0° = side view from the character's right, 90° = front; screen axis R = F·cosθ + L·sinθ; ground travel scaled by cosθ. Default 0°; the approved art is a 3/4 view, so the user is choosing the matching angle
method.scale: rig leg length (thigh 66 + shin 90 px) / BVH leg length (hip→knee→ankle) = 1.794 px/cm
method.pelvis: when a flat foot is planted, pelvis height is chosen so the FK leg (mocap angles, rig lengths) reaches that foot; otherwise BVH hip height × scale + rig ankle height; lowered only if an IK foot is out of reach
method.torso: Hips→Neck sagittal lean minus rest-pose lean, clamped ±0.3 rad, plus existing recoil term
method.feet: pitch from ankle→ball vector (3D horizontal length, toe-out compensated); heel pivot when dorsiflexed, toe pivot when plantarflexed; clearance = min(ankle, ball) height above ground; rig footPose geometry
method.foot_lock: contact = clearance < 1.5 cm and |pitch| < 0.35 rad; pivot world X locked during contact, released with 0.7/frame decay, offset ≤ 6 cm
method.legs: angle-based (2026-11-06 revision): sagittal thigh/shin angles from the mocap drive rig segments by FK (rig lengths 66/90 kept); during ground contact the angles blend toward the 2-bone IK solution to the locked foot; layer 0 (far) = Left, layer 1 (near) = Right
method.upper_body: existing CharacterRig weapon mount, grips and arm IK rigidly re-based onto the mocap torso (IK is invariant under rigid transforms)
method.blend: weight 1 on contact frames; ramps to 0 over 6 frames from frames with clearance < 1.5 cm; reduced by foot pitch 0.25→0.75 rad (toe roll follows FK because the rig boot is shorter than a human foot); FK that would sink the boot is re-solved by IK lifted to the floor

known_limits: lateral (depth) motion is discarded; TR1 sidesteps/turns project with foreshortening
BVH foot (≈25 cm) is longer than the rig boot; contact uses heel/ball pivots, so toe placement is approximate
neutral walk arm swing is not used; arms stay on the rifle
pelvis rotation, head bob from mocap and knee depth ordering are not retargeted
not yet connected to a game scene or to rig-lab's own motion buttons
revision_reason: user reported the rig moving differently from the skeleton; diagnosis: thigh:shin ratio differs (human ≈1:1, rig 66:90 from the approved art) so ankle-position IK produced different knee angles (FW knee flex range 0–64° vs rig 9–49°, corr 0.65)

angle_match_after.remaining: toe-roll frames still bend ~10° less than mocap; swing foot reaches ~9 px further back because the rig shin is longer
